decision: Remove the unused destructive database setup helpers from handler_test.go and product_repo_test.go, along with imports used only by those helpers.
rationale: Integration tests now initialize and reset through the safeintegration schema harness; retaining unreachable table drops, function drops, database creation, or migration runners creates unnecessary destructive SQL risk.
validation: A static architecture regression test asserts both integration test files use safeintegration and do not define the removed helpers; existing safeintegration schema cleanup remains unchanged.
sensitive_data: No production code, migration, database data, or runtime connection setting was changed, and no destructive SQL was executed.
